Samantha, Ben — thanks, I reviewed the attached DPA redlines. High-level summary and asks below.

1) SCCs: We can accept the standard SCCs framework and will include the Article 28 Annex referencing Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/914. We prefer to reference our published SCCs clause and include it as an exhibit to the DPA rather than altering the MSA body text. Is that acceptable?

2) Roles: The redline seeks a more prescriptive split of obligations between Controller and Processor. We will make two clarifying edits: (a) explicitly confirm Redwood acts as processor for the services in the Order Form, and (b) add an exhibit listing typical controller obligations for customer-initiated activities. We cannot accept language that shifts processor liability to Redwood for customer data classification choices.

3) EU-only processing: Operationally feasible for certain workloads if MedAlign commits to the Regional Processing addendum and agrees to the capacity & pricing delta. Laura, can you estimate the monthly surcharge (ballpark) and whether any additional onboarding steps are required?

4) Subprocessor manifest & notifications: We will provide a current manifest and propose a 30-day notification for non-critical additions, 7-day for critical security-impacting subprocessors. We will not commit to a pre-approval regime for every subprocessor; we typically offer an objection process tied to documented and material security concerns.

Action items:
- Karthik: send draft DPA with SCC exhibit and role exhibit by EOD tomorrow (11/3).
- Laura: estimate EU routing surcharge and onboarding delta by EOD 11/3.
- Ben: schedule the 30-min alignment call with Samantha and procurement for 11/3 9:00am PT if that works.

Karthik Iyer

Hi all — following up with the operational notes requested.

- EU routing surcharge: preliminary estimate is a 12% uplift on token-processing line items for EU-only routing due to reserved capacity in EU region and prioritized KV caching. Final will depend on monthly token volumes and peak concurrency.
- Onboarding: EU routing requires workload segmentation, an additional regional onboarding window (~2 weeks), and an internal change request to pin model variants to EU hosts. No change to encryption-at-rest keys; customer-managed KMS is an option.
- Subprocessor info: we can include a manifest with name, role, hosting region, and a one-paragraph security summary (ISO/ SOC reference + primary contact).

I'll attach a short operations note post-call. If MedAlign wants to proceed, we'll produce a pricing addendum and a technical onboarding checklist.
